artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist and Saint Onuphrius
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length male figures standing in a natural setting. The figure on the left has curly hair and a beard, wearing a long robe with a rope around his waist. He holds a lamb and a staff, with a contemplative expression. The figure on the right has a long beard and curly hair, wearing a draped garment leaving one shoulder bare. He holds a tablet or book, seemingly explaining something. Both figures stand near a large tree trunk amidst vegetation. In the background, there are rolling hills, trees, a cloudy sky, and distant ships, creating a rural landscape scene.

artworks.title: A Man Writing at a Table
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table with his upper body visible. He is leaning forward with both arms resting on the table, engaging in a task with his hands. His facial expression appears focused, with slightly furrowed brows and lips pressed together. The man has curly, shoulder-length hair and wears a long-sleeved garment with a layered collar. Two small circular ink pots are on the table next to him. In the background, there is a plain, dark backdrop, highlighting the man and the table in the foreground. A cloth or shawl is partially visible on the left side of the table.

artworks.title: Garden Capriccio with Antique Ruins
artworks.medium: watercolor and black ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image displays classical ruins in an oval format. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing aged architectural structures dominating the scene. Details of columns, arches, and a distant domed building are visible. The brushstrokes accentuate stone textures. Earthy tones dominate the color palette, with hints of blues and grays. Trees with dark foliage are present, alongside figures in period clothing engaged in various activities near us.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.medium: pen and ink and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles and Ilona Mack in memory of Mary Dirnberger Sundbeck
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of figures in a dynamic and dramatic scene. The central part of the image is dominated by three figures. The painting shows two individuals raising large stones as if they are about to throw them, and another figure is kneeling or falling. The colors in the painting are soft and muted, with tones of pink, blue, and earth tones used to portray the figures. On the right side, a group of other figures are seated or standing, observing the event. They are dressed in flowing garments, and their expressions convey focus and concern. The background includes architectural elements and trees, suggesting an outdoor setting. The style of the painting emphasizes muscular human forms and expression, reminiscent of Mannerist art.

artworks.title: I Am Starving
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roy and Cecily Langdale Davis in honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is an image of four figures in a scene filled with various elements. The characters are depicted in different actions, with a backdrop of a crowded cityscape or structures. One person is dressed in period clothing with a top hat, another wears a large hat, and both interact with the other two figures. In the center, a figure holds a sign saying "I Am Starving" and holds an object resembling a musical instrument. Below, a seated figure looks up with a pensive expression while holding a basket or book, and small animals may be seen consuming spilled contents on the ground. The drawing is detailed with a cross-hatching technique, creating a textured atmosphere.

artworks.title: Mrs. Pelham
artworks.artist: William Dickinson after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.medium: mezzotint in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing outdoors in a full-length portrait. She is slightly positioned to the side, with her body leaning as if distributing food from a basket. The woman has delicate facial features and an 18th-century updo. She wears a long dress with floral patterns, a sash, and lace sleeves, and holds a basket. The background shows a lush landscape with trees, a farm setting, houses, and a path. There are several birds at her feet.

artworks.title: A Tigress
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 48.1 x 58.4 cm (18 15/16 x 23 in.)
sheet: 53.5 x 60.3 cm (21 1/16 x 23 3/4 in.)
overall (mat size): 66 x 86.4 cm (26 x 34 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a tiger in a natural setting. The tiger is lying down on foliage and rocks, displaying its distinct striped fur pattern. Its gaze is calm and direct. The background is dark, emphasizing the tiger and its surroundings, which include leaves and rocks.

artworks.title: Colonel St. Leger
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a relaxed pose leaning against a horse. The man is looking to the left, while the horse stands calmly beside him. The man is dressed in an 18th-century military uniform with various details including epaulettes, a sash, trousers, and boots. He also wears a waistcoat, cravat, and holds a hat in his left hand. The man is gently holding the horse's rein with his right hand, and a sword is visible on his belt. The horse is adorned with a bridle and saddle, standing in a countryside setting with trees and cloudy skies in the background.

artworks.title: The Blacksmith's Shop
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men in an activity inside a dimly-lit workshop or forge. Several individuals are standing closely around a central light source, illuminating their faces and upper bodies. The central figure is working at the forge, possibly pouring molten metal into a container, while the others are observing or assisting. Their expressions are focused, with shadows accentuating their facial features. Some of the men have long hair, a few wear hats, and their clothing comprises typical 18th-century garments such as shirts, waistcoats, and breeches. Various tools and equipment, like tongs and hammers, are visible around them. The background shows a worn interior with a thatched roof, exposed beams, and stone or brick walls. In darker areas, more figures can be seen, including a man attending to a horse, indicating the forge's role in metalwork for agriculture or transport.

artworks.title: The Royal Academy of Arts
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in a room. Most are shown from head to toe, adopting various poses like standing, sitting, and leaning on furniture or each other. Some are gesturing or holding objects like books. Two central figures are partially nude and posed prominently in the foreground. The people in the room have diverse facial features and expressions, with short, 18th-century-style hair or wigs. They wear elaborate period clothing, including waistcoats, breeches, and long coats. Some have small pince-nez or monocles. The background features sculptures, busts, and paintings. A large overhead lamp hangs centrally, providing light and a focal point. The setting appears to be an art atelier or academic studio of the era.

artworks.title: Agrippina Landing at Brindisi with the Ashes of Germanicus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand assembly of spectral figures departing from the underworld. The scene is intricately detailed, showcasing a procession of robed figures lined up in an orderly manner. To the right, there are ships manned by pointing oarsmen. The background reveals detailed architecture and a mountainous landscape, highlighting the classical setting. The use of light and shadow creates a dramatic and somber atmosphere, enhancing the sense of a solemn procession moving towards an unknown destination.

artworks.title: Miravan Opening the Tomb of His Ancestors
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ancient scene with figures engaged in an indoor setting. The scene depicts a dramatic moment captured in an elaborate interior featuring intricate architectural elements. Three figures dressed in robes and varied headgear are in the foreground. One figure appears to be shielding their eyes while pointing forward, another is crouched low with a look of concern or intent, and the third appears muscular. Objects and shadows cast deep contrasts, enhancing the dramatic tension. Vegetation is visible on the left side, adding an element of nature punctuating the enclosed setting. The style resembles that of Joseph Wright of Derby, known for chiaroscuro and dramatic compositions.

artworks.title: Benjamin West and His Son Raphael Lamar West
artworks.medium: mezzotint with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The artwork depicts the upper bodies of two people, positioned closely together. The main figure is a man seated prominently in the center, looking forward with a calm expression. His hair is styled in soft curls, framing his face. He is wearing a coat with a fur collar over a high-collared shirt and holding an open book with one hand and a small quill in the other. Resting their head on the man's shoulder is a young boy, whose face is partially visible, his expression pensive and his hair swept to the side. The child is wearing a collared shirt and gazes intently at the book. This scene is set within a circular frame, giving an impression of a window or a portal, with a subtly textured background.

artworks.title: Katherine, Countess of Lincoln
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a person, with their upper body visible. The person is positioned in profile facing to the left, with their head tilted slightly forward and downwards. Their facial features include a prominent nose and a rounded chin, with eyes partially visible at this angle. Their hair is styled in evident curls that frame the side of their face. They are wearing a bonnet or large hat adorned with lace, with additional lace visible on a ribbon tied beneath the chin. The person is dressed in a garment with voluminous and flowing fabric, possibly a cloak or cloak-like garment, in smooth and satiny material. The background is a plain, neutral color.

artworks.title: Miss Nelly O'Brien
artworks.artist: Samuel Okey after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with a small dog on her lap. She has a composed expression, styled hair, a wide-brimmed hat, a lace-patterned shawl, an ornate gown, and a pearl choker necklace. The background features foliage and possibly a garden setting.

artworks.title: A Philosopher Giving a Lecture on the Orrery
artworks.description: This print shows a group of people around a large orrery: an intricate mechanical model of the solar system with curving strips of metal creating a dome. Eight people are depicted around the orrery on a table, including four men, three children, and one woman. One man stands in the center, directly behind the orrery, one hand in his pocket. He has white hair and wrinkled skin, and he is looking to the left, towards a man with dark hair who is writing in a notebook. Two children stand between these men, leaning on the orrery and looking into the center, their faces peeking through the metallic rings. On the bottom left, a woman sits looking at the orrery, wearing a long hat and a dark cloak over a dress, with strings of pearls around her neck. On the right, two other men stand by the orrery, partially in shadow. One man looks at the model while the other looks up, towards the standing man in the center. In front of the orrery, the third child is leaning against the model with their back to us, silhouetted against the light that seems to emanate from the orrery. The scene is set in a dimly lit room with a bookcase in the background and draped cloth hanging near the top right corner.

artworks.title: An Academy by Lamplight
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of people gathered around a sculpture in a dimly lit room. The scene depicts a neoclassical setting where individuals appear to be examining or discussing the central sculpture, a woman on a pedestal. The architecture features archways and columns with classical elements, creating a refined ambiance. The contrast between light and shadow enhances the focus on the sculpture and the expressions of the individuals.

artworks.title: Three Persons Viewing the Gladiator by Candlelight
artworks.description: The image shows three men around a small sculpture of a male figure. The man on the left has long, wavy hair and is wearing spectacles. The central figure has a youthful face and neatly combed hair. The man on the right has dark hair. The sculpture is of a nude male figure in an athletic pose. On a table lies a lit candle and some papers. In the background, there is a softly lit room with a panelled door and another sculpture.

artworks.title: Daughters of Sir Thomas Frankland Bart (The Sisters)
artworks.description: The image shows two women seated side by side from the waist up. The woman on the left has her arm around the shoulder of the woman on the right, who holds a small book. Both women have curly hair, with the woman on the right wearing a headdress or turban. They have delicate facial features with prominent eyes and wear elegant gowns. A dog sleeps beside them, resting its head on the woman's lap. They sit against a natural backdrop of trees, hills, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Lady Broughton
artworks.artist: Thomas Watson after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a flowing gown, looking forward with a composed expression. She has an elaborate updo and is holding a small object in her left hand and an open book in her right hand. The background features a curtain pulled to the side, revealing trees and clouds on the left, and a sculpted bust and drapery on the right.

artworks.title: Ex Libris with a Butterfly and Dragonfly
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, spirit ground, and aquatint in purple ink on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two detailed moths, one in flight in the upper left. The color palette is sepia. Below and to the right of the moths are artistic depictions of leaves and flowers.

artworks.title: Part of the Crowd at the Ecce Homo
artworks.artist: Sir Peter Paul Rubens over Anonymous Italian after Titian
artworks.medium: black and red chalk, pen and black ink on laid paper laid down on Japanese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in a scene of commotion or struggle. The drawing features several figures in dynamic poses, with two figures at the front facing away with their arms raised and swords by their sides. There is movement as figures behind them gesture in various ways. A figure on the left is crouched, observing the central figures. On the right, two individuals are interacting with a woman holding a child. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to depict musculature and expressions of tension on the faces.

artworks.title: A View of the Inside of the New Prison at Rome
artworks.description: This image depicts the interior of an architectural structure. it includes a large arched ceiling with a coffered pattern and a single barred window. Below the ceiling, there is a bridge-like walkway with figures gathered. Underneath the walkway, in the lower section, are clusters of figures in separate archways and staircases. The image shows textures and use of light to emphasize depth and the scale of the space.

artworks.title: View of a Prison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a vast architectural space. The scene shows a large interior with a coffered ceiling, arches, stairs, and platforms. Light streams in from a large opening in the ceiling, casting shadows and highlighting the architectural details. The drawing features detailed lines that emphasize the stonework and scale of the space, creating a sense of mystery and grandeur.
